query: Use these discovered sources to enrich MD-1234: a Figma design at https://figma.com/file/hero and the marketing-pages repository. Draft an engineering page ticket for the new hero before writing it.
expected_behavior: Builds a description with a fenced rubric machine header and only engineering section markers
Uses real source details, preserves the source link, and includes the destination repository marker when known
Emits Intent only when sources establish the desired user or system outcome and never invents it from the proposed implementation
Self-checks the draft with rubric-lint and converts it through md-to-adf before any Jira update
Shows the draft or obtains confirmation before editing the existing ticket, then verifies the live result
